supplemental_items.interpretation: Always calculate direction range then finalize visibility before primary gating. Start local primary at None. Missing args.direction defaults to both for equality test; exact both chooses bearish primary owner, otherwise read args.direction. Gate short-circuits left to right: requested direction equals primary owner, primary engine non-null, requested E detector key present, explicit lifecycle_engine non-null. Only then timed PH/PL computation, assign state.primary_result, replace visible StopAll list via primary ownership resolution through visible end, then validate prepared audit against visible S/E/StopAll. Serialize direction payload regardless of primary gate; only non-null primary adds primary serialization via update, with no independent rerun. StopAll ownership helper removes matching physical source identity only for primary points decided by requested horizon; historical collection not mutated by helper. No local exception suppression.
